read_root_plan.change_is: The existing 49 Financial read function's environment map gains one entry, IRPT_FORWARD_COTTONWOOD_FUNCTION, as an in-place update of that function; the one added resource is the forward role policy in forward.tf.

words: Cell DB-b-320 adds the Terraform of the Cottonwood Performance read path, applying the issuer's reference diff unchanged. A new root reporting-read-iso holds the Cottonwood reporting-read Lambda through the yang-lambda module (29 s, 512 MB, no layer, no reserved concurrency), its own execution role, the platinum reporting read and list grant, the scope-dependency read grant and the service-profile read. Every name is builder output, and the role carries the firm scope token the bucket fence admits. The function's environment carries the directory map and the registry path only, never the forward variable, and the root has no route, schedule, topic, mail or permission resource. The reporting-read root gains forward.tf, one lambda:InvokeFunction statement on the one builder-named Cottonwood function with no S3 action, and one forward environment line in its function. Not proven: nothing was validated by terraform, planned or applied, since the box has no terraform binary; the iso root cannot plan until the function-map entry of the new function exists, which is the next cell; the artifact differs only when the pinned served.py moves; and every plan figure here is inferred, not measured.
